heading: iPhone 16 Plus is now available at a lower price
paragraphs: With iPhone prices rising, the iPhone 16 Plus could be an option worth exploring. The smartphone is currently available at a lower price on Flipkart, giving buyers an opportunity to save some money.
The iPhone 16 Plus is now listed at Rs 79,900 on Flipkart, compared to its launch price of Rs 89,900.
That’s a flat saving of Rs 10,000 on the iPhone 16 Plus. And if that wasn’t enough, there’s an additional offer that can bring the price down even further.
If you are a holder of a Flipkart Axis or Flipkart SBI credit card, you can avail a cashback of Rs 3,995.
With the additional offer, you can bring the effective price of the iPhone 16 Plus down to Rs 75,905.
Under the hood, the iPhone 16 Plus uses the A18 chipset. During our review, the device could easily handle multitasking and long gaming sessions on titles like Genshin Impact.
On the front, the iPhone 16 Plus packs a 6.7-inch OLED display with the Dynamic Island. While the screen delivers punchy colours, it is a 60Hz panel.
For optics, the iPhone 16 Plus packs a 48-megapixel main, and a 12-megapixel ultrawide. Both sensors give you decent results with good colours and detail.
For us, the iPhone 16 usually lasted for a day and some more on a single charge, even after some heavy use. You get USB-C and MagSafe for charging.
